sections.heading: Type power
lines: Rock moves and grass moves are 1.2× stronger.
Diamond Storm, Rock Slide, Rock Tomb, Smack Down, and Stone Edge also count as Poison for type matchups.
Gunk Shot and Sludge Wave also count as Rock for type matchups.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Apple Acid and Seed Flare: 1.5× stronger.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Poison-type.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Purify, Seed Flare, Solar Beam, and Solar Blade change the field into Cave.
Blast Burn, Eruption, Heat Wave, Inferno Overdrive, and Lava Plume change the field into Volcanic.

sections.heading: Each turn
lines: Dry Skin restores 1/8 of its HP.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Synthetic Seed: Defense +2 and suffers bad poison.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
